meta.title: Submitting the award puts it into approval, no longer a draft
gaps: There is no operation or library case for submitting the award while choosing an applicable approval flow.
There is no readable award-status field or operation to verify that the award is requested (waiting for approval) rather than draft.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event where the invited QA vendor bid, and the bidding window is over.
steps: The buyer opens an award proposal.
The buyer awards the line to a vendor on the proposal for the invited QA vendor.
